concerns.text: Tasks T076-T081 (Phase 5) implement features (Admissible Question Language, Productive Ignorance Metric, System 2 Checkpoint) that are not defined in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008). These tasks have no matching FR/SC in the specification, constituting unapproved scope creep. The spec explicitly limits scope to FR-001 through FR-008.

Tasks T079 and T080 are tagged with [FR-006], but FR-006 strictly defines 'Statistical analysis must rigorously compare... baselines'. These tasks implement new metrics (PI_score, Confidence Calibration) not described in FR-006. There is no FR/SC in the spec that authorizes the implementation of these specific metrics.

The 'REJECTED' section in Phase 2 references task IDs T014a and T014b which do not exist in the current tasks.md file. This indicates stale tags or a broken dependency map from a previous version of the plan.

Task T015b implements the ablation study for FR-007 by repeating '[NEUTRAL]' tokens. While it attempts to match token length, the spec's intent for FR-007 is to isolate the *content* of the signal. The current implementation risks introducing a confounding variable (repetition pattern) rather than a truly neutral placeholder. A task explicitly addressing the generation of a semantically void but structurally diverse placeholder is missing to fully satisfy FR-007's intent.
